name: depphunter
description: Browse the workspace as an interactive isometric city, in the editor's built-in browser.

depphunter.path.markdownDescription: The `depphunter` binary. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; an absolute path is used as given. Releases: [github.com/sarumaj/depphunter-cli/releases](https://github.com/sarumaj/depphunter-cli/releases).

depphunter.watch.description: Re-analyze on file changes and update the map live (--watch).

depphunter.style.description: What the map is dressed as. "default" leaves it to the config files.

depphunter.findings.markdownDescription: Scanner reports to place on the map (`--findings`), relative to the workspace folder. Globs are allowed.

depphunter.args.markdownDescription: Further arguments, one per entry, e.g. `["--exclude", "vendor", "--lsp"]`. Run `depphunter --help` for the list.

enumDescriptions: A tab of the editor's own. The only one where walk mode can capture the mouse.
The editor's built-in browser, which has an address bar but withholds the pointer lock.
The default browser, outside the editor.

depphunter.editorCommand.markdownDescription: What the map's "Open in editor" button runs, e.g. `code -g {file}:{line}`. Empty means this editor, when its command-line launcher can be found, and otherwise whatever depphunter detects.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test extension/test/binary.test.js extension/test/extension.test.js
